Theorem
[Lichnerowicz identity for symmetric tensors]

Source: petersen:page-0364 ↗ def:pet-ch9-codazzi-exterior-derivative ↗ def:pet-ch9-weitzenbock-curvature-operator 1. ch9:9.4.3For every symmetric $(0,2)$-tensor $h$ and vector $X$, \[ ( abla _X abla ^*h)(X)+( abla ^*d^ abla h)(X,X) =( abla ^* abla h)(X,X)+ frac 12(\operatorname {Ric}(h))(X,X). \]
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch9-symmetric-tensor-lichnerowicz-identity \sketch At the evaluation point use a normal frame to expand $ abla _X abla ^*h$ and $ abla ^*d^ abla h$. Their second-derivative terms combine to $ abla ^* abla h$; commuting the remaining derivatives gives $(R(E_i,X)h)(E_i,X)$. Symmetry of $h$ identifies this contraction with $ frac 12\operatorname {Ric}(h)(X,X)$.

□
